name: MyZubster Growth & Ecosystem

methodology.principle: Separate visibility, participation and adoption. Do not convert them into a single popularity score.
methodology.visibility: Public web/social mentions are visibility signals only.
methodology.participation: Public GitHub aliases and contributions are participation signals backed by inspectable artifacts.
methodology.adoption: Independent integrations, deployments and repeated external use require stronger public evidence.
methodology.privacy: Do not identify passive visitors or correlate anonymous website analytics with GitHub identities.

sources.label: Weekly Adoption Scorecard
sources.supports: IWAU, new external contributors, merged PRs, integrations, deployments, demos and quickstarts

sources.label: Public Community & External Web Activity
sources.supports: external GitHub interactions and public web/social mentions

sources.label: Contributor Registry
sources.supports: public contributor aliases and evidence states

sources.label: Independent Showcase
sources.supports: merged external contributions, integrations, deployments and repeated adoption

next_measurements: Add one conservative weekly snapshot for external contributor activity.
Track profile-to-MyZubster and Community entry clicks with privacy-safe aggregate analytics.
Track first-time Community registrations and returning active community members as aggregate counts.
Keep stars, forks and page views as attention metrics, not adoption evidence.
Promote independent integrations, deployments and reproducible demos only when public evidence exists.
